utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Klar, ich bin gleich da. Sag mir nur kurz, was noch fehlt.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Es fehlt eigentlich nur noch die Bohrmaschine und zwei längere Schrauben. Ich bring sie gleich rüber.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Alles klar, ich warte hier. Ruf mich, wenn du beides hast.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need to know when the repairs start and who’s handling the materials.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the start date and who’s bringing the materials?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help once I know the exact start date and who’s bringing the materials.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, the repair drive. I might've missed an update, what changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I think the update was that a few repairs got pushed back a day or two. I might be remembering that wrong, though.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds about right. I’ll keep an eye out in case I missed another update.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help get the repair drive going; I’ll let folks know the plan and keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Vik. Let me know if you need me to spread the word or check on anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word and keep the plan moving; if anything comes up, I’ll check back with you.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late what’s left on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help with whatever’s left.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll keep it simple: what time are we starting, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: We’re starting at 9 a.m., and if you can bring gloves and a screwdriver, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ll bring gloves and a screwdriver, and I’ll be there at 9 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How far along is the repair drive, and what do you still need from me?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s moving along well. I still need a few more hands and any spare tools you can lend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I can lend a couple of tools, and I’ll come by to help. What time should I bring them?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I heard the repair drive is moving along, and I can help connect folks if you need another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would help a lot, Jules. I’m keeping track of the addresses and can point you to the next places that need attention.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I’ll keep moving folks along and send anyone needing help your way.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that, Rosa. Tell me what needs fixing and I’ll see what I can do.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara. The repair drive needs hands on a few porch steps, a leaky faucet at 214, and a loose gate on Cedar Street. I’ll write it up and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a few extra screws and some gloves if we need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, those will help. I’ll grab the drive over there and get started.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll keep the spare parts handy while you work.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s picking up this afternoon, and folks are dropping off tools near the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I might swing by after lunch if I can.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like a good time to stop by if you can. They said they could use hands, and I bet they’ll still be setting things out after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sure, I can help with that. What exactly needs fixing on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s mostly the loose latch on the rear gate, and I’m not sure if the power drill is still at the garage. Could you take a look this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What’s the repair drive for?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It’s for fixing up the old community hall before the winter potluck.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can keep an eye on the repair drive and pass the plan along.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik. I’ll let the others know the plan and keep the updates moving.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’ll keep passing the plan along and stay on top of the updates.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, the repair drive... I think I saw something about that, but I may have missed the latest update.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, I saw the update too, but I haven’t had a chance to look closely yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, same here. I should probably check the full update before I say anything about it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you want, Gus. What needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Let’s start with the leaky faucet in the kitchen. I’ve got a wrench if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I’ll take a look at the faucet. Hand me the wrench and I’ll start under the sink.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ve got the sign-up sheets ready, and I’m hoping we can get a few more hands for the repair drive this week.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check with a few neighbors on Maple and Pine; that usually brings in a couple more hands.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Opal. I’ll keep the sheets close by and make sure we’re ready if they can bring anyone along.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I need the schedule and a clear drop-off point before I can say yes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ll send the schedule and the drop-off point right over, so you can decide once you’ve got both.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Send them when you can, and I’ll take a look once I have both.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, I just wanted to make sure.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me. Tell me when you want to head out, and I’ll keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m ready whenever you are. Just give me the word and I’ll head out with you.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: All right, let’s head out now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I just heard there’s a repair drive happening, but I’m a little behind on the details. What’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yeah, I heard it’s this weekend at the community hall. They’re collecting tools, batteries, and any spare cords people can part with.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s helpful — I should round up a few extra cords and batteries then.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive. I meant to bring my tool kit, but I may have left it by the door again.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: No worries, we can still use mine. I’ve got the list by the porch if you want to grab what you need.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, I can grab it after all. I’ll head by the porch and bring whatever we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup, but I need a little more detail about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What kind of repairs does the drive need, and where should I bring the stuff?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s mostly small household repairs like loose hinges, leaky faucets, and patching hardware, and you can bring it to the church hall by the front entrance after 3.
